estilo: One ordinary frame from a normal handheld video shot by a family member at eye level, in the middle of the action: slightly off framing, something cut by the edge, almost everything in focus, only the real light of the place (ceiling light, window daylight, a fridge light), natural white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects, people caught mid-movement, not posing, no beautiful composition.
